summary: Gifford Pinchot NF lookout site, Skamania Co.: 1920 cupola cabin, 1936 L-4 cab, lost in 1970. Footings, a root cellar and a rock wall remain; reached by a 2.5-mile trail.

facts.design: 12-by-12-foot cupola cabin (1920), replaced by an L-4 cab (1936)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the cupola cabin to 1924. Contemporary 1920 newspaper reports (quoted by WillhiteWeb and the weebly page) and Mazamas' repeat of an Oregon Hikers note all give 1920. The story follows the 1920 reports.

The register and the weebly page say the L-4 cab was removed; firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb say destroyed. All four date the loss to 1970, so the story says it left the summit in 1970 and reports both words.

sources.title: Little Huckleberry Mtn. Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Main open question is the cupola build year: 1920 in the 1920 newspaper reports (via two history sites) and Mazamas, against 1924 in the register and firelookout.com. The story follows the contemporary reports. Today's remains come from WillhiteWeb's 2015 visit photo captions and a secondhand Oregon Hikers note; no current visit is documented. Access is public from the WillhiteWeb trailhead description; no gate or permit is mentioned. The brief's kind 'ground' fits the cabin-on-summit record; no correction proposed. The 1936 panorama date rests on the weebly page's transcription.
